code_system: LOINC 2.82 (https://loinc.org/). Every code is checked against the HL7 terminology server by scripts/terminology/build_terminology.py loinc; the result is server/terminology/data/loinc-verified.json
notes: Reference intervals are facts transcribed from the cited public tables; no source text is reproduced.
Sex 'any' applies to both sexes. Age bands are adult (18 to 120) unless stated; paediatric bands are not yet authored (CALIPER import pending, see docs/architecture/14).
critical_low / critical_high are the mean US critical limits reported by Kost 1990 unless another source is named in critical_source.
Every analyte carries source (URL) and reviewed_at; the engine refuses to emit a value for an analyte without them.
low or high null means the interval is open on that side (for example HDL at or above 40 mg/dL).
source_numbers lists the figures as printed on the source page when the stored bound is a unit conversion of them.
absent_unless_exposed: a drug or toxin that is not detected unless the case exposes the patient to it.
derived: computed by the engine from other analytes of the same draw (anion gap, eGFR, globulin).
